messages:
anya: Heads up — packaging found a checksum drift in the onprem offline-installer tar for rc2. Thinking holdback? deploy-bot already had a window for tonight.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: private-vpc/installer v1.8.0-rc2 -> staging-canary at 2026-03-22T22:00Z. Pin tag: rc2-staging. If anomalies detected use /rollback 1.8.0-rc1 or abort via /hold.
sam: Where's the diff? I saw a mismatched md5 vs sha256 earlier on the mirror.
anya: Packaging logs show a different gzip header on the x86 bundle from ci-artifacts mirror; sha256 disagrees. I re-ran locally:
```
$ sha256sum offline-installer-v1.8.0-rc2.tar.gz
d34db33f2a7a...  offline-installer-v1.8.0-rc2.tar.gz
# expected: c0ffeec0bebaf00d...
```
maria: Could be a mirror reupload glitch or a shrinkwrap rerun that didn't re-sign.
lee: We should pause the canary until we confirm whether signer/KMS rotation changed the manifest. ops-oncall can you validate cosign sigs + timestamps?
ops-oncall: Checking cosign signatures now. Quick scan: one submanifest signature shows expiry 2026-02-28 — that looks odd. Pulling CI logs.
anya: Found root cause: signer rotated on 2026-02-28 but the packaging job used the old signed blob from the mirror cache. CI re-signed, mirror didn't refresh, so artifact mismatch.
sam: Immediate action proposal: hold the deploy, repackage with the current signer, update shrinkwrap manifest, re-run checksum + cosign. Agree?
maria: :thumbsup: Agree. Also update release notes to call out the key rotation + re-signing step so customers see the delay reason.
deploy-bot: Holding scheduled deploy. Canaries paused. Runbook snippet: `scripts/packager/repackage.sh --signer=live && scripts/packager/verify.sh && cosign sign <artifact>` then `deploy-bot /schedule 22:30Z` to reschedule.
anya: I'll kick the repackage now and open a small PR to pin the signer version in the packager job so we don't flip mid-delivery.
ops-oncall: Re-publishing the mirror after repackage. Estimated extra 20-30m. Will post final checksum and cosign ack when done.
lee: Rollback criteria unchanged: abort if >1% client-side checksum failures or any cosign signature mismatch observed in canary. Also abort if API-serving latency regresses >20%.
sam: Also let's tag artifacts/images with `rc2-20260322-signed` to avoid ambiguous tags during mirror churn.
maria: I'll update the release notes draft and the canary checklist. Ping when you have the reschedule time.
anya: Posting new checksum after repackage: `sha256: c0ffeec0bebaf00d9a7f...` — matches expected. Re-uploaded to mirror and triggered cosign signing.
ops-oncall: Cosign verification OK. Mirror checksum verified end-to-end. Re-enabled deploy window at 22:45Z. deploy-bot will reschedule if no objections in next 5m.
lee: :rocket: Reschedule OK from me. Please add a one-line postmortem to the release notes about the hold + packager pin fix.
sam: Thanks all. ACTIONS: anya = repackage + PR to pin signer, ops-oncall = mirror republish + cosign, maria = release notes + checklist, sam = watch canary and metrics.
